lines.t: In the quiet of the seventh day
You call my weary heart to stay
Your whisper falls like gentle rain
And in your presence peace remains
You say, my son, come walk with me
Let all your striving cease and be
And in the stillness of your grace
My soul finds rest in your embrace
Every burden starts to fall
When I hear your sacred call
You speak and all my fears resign
Your Sabbath rest becomes mine
So I rest in your light
Where the day shines soft and holy
I breathe in your peace
And my heart is filled completely
For you made this day for love
A place where I am home again
In your presence, Lord, I find Sabbath rest that never ends
You say, walk with me and you'll be blessed
For those who trust in me find rest
Your footsteps guide, your truth aligns
My wandering soul with what is divine
For a day with you is like a thousand years
Refuge strong from all my fear
You set apart the sacred time
A holy gift, a love divine
Every heartbeat slows to peace
As your healing never leaves
Your spirit settles deep within
And makes me whole again
So I rest in your light
Where the day shines soft and holy
I breathe in Your peace
And my heart is filled completely
For You made this day for love
A place where I am whole again
In Your presence, Lord, I find
Sabbath rest that never ends
Here in the quiet you speak to me
Revealing all you've called me to be
No striving left, no fear to fight
Just your mercy, soft and bright
And as I lay beside your ways
My soul learns how to truly stay
In the peace You sanctified Before the earth was made alive
So I rest in Your light Where Your love shines full and healing
I breathe in Your peace Every wound within You're mending
For You made this day for joy A place where I can rise again
In Your presence, Lord, I find Sabbath rest that never ends
Thank you.
